patch_description: This variant emphasizes large direct demands using the suggested 0.85/0.15 blend, while retaining a concave component so moderate demands still influence link selection. It adds sparse two-hop rewards for promising relay paths, ranking relays by the strength of both legs and discounting nodes with high incident traffic. The relay budget is kept small to limit interaction-graph density and preserve useful QAOA communities. Degree penalties remain the evaluator’s responsibility.
